name: ovos-media-plugin-mpv
description: `ovos-media-plugin-mpv` is an audio and video playback plugin for OpenVoiceOS (OVOS). It drives the mpv media player through `python-mpv-jsonipc` and exposes it as a playback backend for ovos-media and the legacy `ovos-audio` service.
author: OpenVoiceOS

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
Install the plugin with pip:

pip install ovos-media-plugin-mpv

The plugin needs the `mpv` media player installed and available on the system.
